header: A poster image with a play button
bodytext:
The film loads only when someone presses play: it sits in a closed dialog, which the browser neither shows nor loads until it opens.

The link field holds the video’s address, not a page. The note carries the running time and the caption the credit.
caption: Film: “TYPO3 v14 LTS — The Next Generation”, published by the TYPO3 project in April 2026.
note: 28 min 46 s · in English, played from YouTube’s privacy-enhanced domain
